evade.label: Don't get hit
evade.desc: Make enemy attacks against you (or an ally) miss more often.

attacker-banes.label: Banes on enemies' attacks against you

resist.label: Shrug off effects
resist.desc: Beat the spells, conditions and afflictions aimed at you. These make YOU roll to resist, so boons on your challenge rolls help — and cures clean up what lands.

mitigate.label: Take less when hit
mitigate.desc: Reduce or absorb the damage that does land.

land-hits.label: Land your attacks
land-hits.desc: Raise your own attack accuracy, or soften a target so it's easier to hit.

target-softening.label: Boons on attacks against the target

boost-damage.label: Hit harder
boost-damage.desc: Add to the damage of your weapon / unarmed attacks. Flat and dice bonuses add up.

suppress-enemy.label: Blunt the enemy
suppress-enemy.desc: Cut an enemy's offense: banes on its own rolls, or deny its actions outright.

combos.rationale: Raise Defense + Banes on enemies' attacks against you: two different levers on “don't get hit”, so they compound instead of fighting each other's diminishing returns. Both pieces are also strong for their rank.

Banes on enemies' attacks against you + Concealment / hard to target: two different levers on “don't get hit”, so they compound instead of fighting each other's diminishing returns. Both pieces are also strong for their rank.

Reduce incoming damage + Extra / temporary Health: two different levers on “take less when hit”, so they compound instead of fighting each other's diminishing returns. Both pieces are also strong for their rank.

Banes on the target's rolls + Stun / immobilize / slow: two different levers on “blunt the enemy”, so they compound instead of fighting each other's diminishing returns.

Multiple sources of stun / immobilize / slow. These are flat bonuses, so they add up — pile them on.

Boons to land the unarmed strike plus stacked extra damage on it: accuracy and damage on the same attack, the brawler's core.

Every one of these adds extra damage to unarmed/natural-weapon attacks, and extra-damage dice add together — a brawler can layer them all onto the same punch.

control.name: Mad Piping of the Outer Dark

notes.direction: A boon adds a d6 and helps the roller; a bane subtracts a d6 and hurts the roller. Offence vs defence is about whose roll carries it: defence = banes on the enemy's attack against you, or boons on your own challenge rolls (to resist effects); offence = boons on your attack rolls, or banes on the target's rolls.
notes.boons_banes: Boons and banes on one roll pool together and only the single highest d6 applies (E[max]: 1d6=3.5, 2d6=4.47, 3d6=4.96). Stacking the same roll-lever diminishes fast.
notes.flat_bonuses: Flat Defense bonuses and extra-damage dice add together, so stacking the same flat lever is linear and worth it.
notes.compounding: The strongest combos pair different levers toward one goal (e.g. raise Defense AND impose banes on the enemy's attack against you): each avoids the other's diminishing returns.
notes.precast: Minute+/hour buffs can be cast before the fight, so they cost no action economy once combat starts. Holding 2+ concentration spells is fragile: taking damage forces a challenge roll to keep each.
notes.quality: Where a member has a measurable output, its `quality` is that spell's rank-cohort percentile from score_spells.py (0..1). Showcases prefer pairs built from individually-strong pieces, and combos of strong pieces score higher.
